events.title: Sakurajima Volcano
events.description: Active stratovolcano dominating Kinkō Bay—ferry access and multiple observation points around the island.

events.title: Sengan-en Garden & Shōko Shūseikan
events.description: Shimazu clan villa garden with borrowed views of Sakurajima; part of Japan’s Meiji Industrial Revolution sites.

events.title: Shiroyama Observatory
events.description: Classic city lookout for day and night panoramas of Kagoshima and Sakurajima across the bay.
